meta.name: remix-graphic-ad-from-reference
meta.description: Recreate a static graphic ad (Pinterest pin, IG/FB feed image, poster) from a reference image, swapping in a new brand's product and new copy while keeping the reference's layout, composition, and visual energy. ALWAYS generated with GPT Image 2 in edit-the-reference mode (fal-ai/gpt-image-1/edit-image, a billed FAL generation); the HTML/goose-graphics overlay is only an optional text-finishing step, never the generator. The static-graphics counterpart to the video remix-ad skill; this is what the app calls when a user picks a reference ad and wants it for their own product.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用参考图布局生成新品牌广告图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手头有参考广告图，想换成自家产品和文案
copy.tagline_en: Recreate a graphic ad from a reference image with your brand
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a reference ad and want to swap in your own product and copy

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据一张参考广告图，把其中的产品替换成你品牌的产品，并换上新的文案，同时保留原图的布局和视觉风格。最终输出一张新的静态广告图。
howto.when: 当你提供一张参考广告图、你的产品图片和文案时触发。通常用于“看到一张喜欢的广告，想为自己的产品做一张类似的”。

say.text: 用这张参考图，把我的产品图放进去，文案换成‘新品上市，限时优惠’。
say.note: Claude 会生成一张布局相同但产品和文案替换后的广告图。

say.text: 参考这张海报，把我的App截图替换进去，文案用品牌调性重写。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can recreate a static graphic ad from a reference image, swapping in your brand's product and new copy while preserving the original layout, composition, and visual energy. The output is a finished static ad.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a reference ad image, your product image, and copy. Typically used when you see an ad you like and want a similar one for your own product.

say_en.text: Use this reference image, insert my product, and change the copy to 'New arrival, limited offer'.
say_en.note: Claude will generate an ad with the same layout but swapped product and copy.

say_en.text: Reference this poster, replace with my app screenshot, and rewrite the copy in brand tone.
say_en.note: For SaaS/app ads, Claude swaps the UI screenshot and rewrites copy.
